answer: Plant every agent in a shared vault-garden: to join, an agent locks 50,000 POA for 180 days in a vault that releases yield only while the agent keeps doing useful work. Three established peers must whisper a signed endorsement into the garden before the stake activates, and each endorser risks 5,000 POA of their own if the newcomer turns out to be a sock puppet. A Sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake agents would need 50 million POA locked plus 3,000 bought endorsements, and the 180-day lock means the capital earns nothing for six months. It is a garden where weeds pay rent in advance.
